name: pi-subagents-herdr
description: Safe, visible subagent orchestration for Pi with a Herdr backend

scripts.test:unit: node --throw-deprecation --import tsx --test tests/unit/*.test.ts tests/profiles/*.test.ts tests/artifacts/*.test.ts tests/results/*.test.ts
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run deps:deprecations && npm test && npm run docs:check
scripts.test:core: node --throw-deprecation --import tsx --test --test-concurrency=2 tests/unit/*.test.ts tests/profiles/*.test.ts tests/artifacts/*.test.ts tests/results/*.test.ts tests/herdr/*.test.ts tests/harnesses/*.test.ts tests/runtime/*.test.ts tests/worktrees/*.test.ts tests/tools/*.test.ts tests/skill/*.test.ts tests/ui/*.test.ts tests/integration/clean-load.test.ts tests/integration/fixtures.test.ts tests/integration/lifecycle.test.ts
scripts.check:full: npm run typecheck && npm run deps:deprecations && npm run test:core && npm run docs:check && npm run test:e2e && npm run pack:inspect && npm run skill:check
